emailVerification.explanation: Welcome to {{companyName}}. Confirm that {{email}} belongs to you to activate your account and start using it.

fallback.beforeLink: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:

emailVerification.notice: If you didn't create this account, you can safely ignore this email.

passwordReset.preview: Reset the password for your {{companyName}} account
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.explanation: We received a request to reset the password for {{email}}. Choose a new password with the button below. The link only works once.

fallback.beforeLink: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:

passwordReset.notice: If you didn't request a password reset, you can ignore this email — your password stays unchanged.

support.beforeEmail: If you didn't request this or need help, contact us at

footer.transactionalNotice: This is a transactional email about the {{companyName}} account for {{email}}.

guestUserCreated.preview: Finish setting up the {{companyName}} account that was created for you
guestUserCreated.heading: Complete your account
guestUserCreated.explanation: An account on {{companyName}} was created for {{email}}. Pick a username and password with the button below to finish setting it up — until then the account stays incomplete and can't be signed in to.

fallback.beforeLink: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:

guestUserCreated.notice: If you weren't expecting this, you can safely ignore this email — the account stays incomplete and nobody can sign in to it.

support.beforeEmail: If you didn't expect this account or need help completing it, contact us at

footer.transactionalNotice: This is a transactional email about the {{companyName}} account for {{email}}.

usageLimitReached.preview: Your {{affectedResources}} are used up for this billing cycle
usageLimitReached.heading: Usage limit reached
usageLimitReached.explanation: Your {{affectedResources}} are used up for the current billing cycle. From now until the cycle resets, workflows stop being executed and AI generation is refused for whichever of the two ran out. Upgrading the plan lifts the limit immediately.
usageLimitReached.notice: Usage is counted per billing cycle, so the counters clear on their own on the date above - nothing needs to be done if waiting is fine.

support.beforeEmail: To raise the limit or to go through the usage with us, contact us at

footer.transactionalNotice: This is a transactional email about the {{companyName}} account for {{email}}.

usageLimitWarning.heading: Close to the usage limit
usageLimitWarning.explanation: You have used {{thresholdPercentage}} of your {{affectedResources}} for the current billing cycle. Nothing is blocked yet - but once the limit is reached, workflows stop being executed and AI generation is refused until the cycle resets.
usageLimitWarning.notice: Upgrading the plan lifts the limit immediately; otherwise the counters clear on their own on the date above.

support.beforeEmail: To raise the limit or to go through the usage with us, contact us at

footer.transactionalNotice: This is a transactional email about the {{companyName}} account for {{email}}.

licenseRemoved.heading: License removed
licenseRemoved.explanation: Your license was removed, so its entitlements no longer apply. AI tokens and workflow executions now run on the limits that apply without a license, and anything beyond them is blocked until a license is added again.
licenseRemoved.notice: Projects, flows and data are untouched by this - only the entitlements are gone. If the removal was not intended, add the license again and everything continues where it left off.

support.beforeEmail: If you didn't expect this or need help restoring the license, contact us at

footer.transactionalNotice: This is a transactional email about the {{companyName}} account for {{email}}.
